name: Springing Back
source:
A Saint Bernard named Konrad arrived to a snowy land for vacation with his boyfriend. Upon arriving at the airport, he receives devastating news from his boyfriend. However, unexpectedly a Snow Leopard named Tai Zhou takes him in before a storm hits. In a short time, his experience with Tai Zhou changes him for the better.

[From [url=https://waterhusky.itch.io/breaking-the-ice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
圣伯纳犬康拉德与男友来到一片雪国度假。刚到机场，他就收到男友传来的噩耗。然而，在暴风雪来临前，一只名叫Tai Zhou的雪豹，意外收留了他。短暂的相处中，与Tai Zhou的经历，让他朝着更好的方向改变。

[摘自[url=https://waterhusky.itch.io/breaking-the-ice]Itch.io[/url]]
